title: European Stroke Organisation Guideline on Reversal of Oral Anticoagulants in Acute Intracerebral Haemorrhage

recommendations.section: PICO 1: PCC versus no treatment in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: In adults with ICH occurring during use of VKA (with an INR above normal), we recommend using PCC (30 IU/kg) to decrease mortality and normalise INR.

recommendations.section: PICO 2: PCC versus FFP in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: In patients with VKA-induced ICH, we recommend PCC (30 IU/kg) over FFP (20 mL/kg) to decrease mortality and normalise INR.

recommendations.section: PICO 2: PCC versus FFP in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: Expert opinion (vote: six of six experts): In patients with VKA-induced ICH, we recommend to use PCC dosages in the range from 20 to 50 IU/kg if INR >= 2 and 10 to 20 IU/kg if 1.3 <= INR < 2.

recommendations.section: PICO 3: Vitamin K in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: In adult patients with ICH occurring during use of VKA (with an INR >= 1.3), we recommend the initial use of vitamin K (10 mg intravenously (IV)) in addition to fast reversal strategies including PCC to prevent re-increase of INR, to decrease haematoma expansion and decrease mortality.

recommendations.section: PICO 4: Recombinant factor VIIa in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: We recommend against using rFVIIa to improve outcome, decrease haematoma expansion or increase normalisation of INR in patients with ICH occurring during use of VKA.

recommendations.section: PICO 5: Tranexamic acid in VKA-related ICH
recommendations.text: In adult patients with ICH occurring during use of VKA and INR >= 1.3, we recommend against use of tranexamic acid.

In patients with ICH occurring during use of NOAC and when specific reversal agents are not available, we recommend considering the use of four-factor PCC (37.5-50 IU/kg) to normalise coagulation tests.
In patients with ICH occurring during use of NOAC, we recommend against using FFP to improve outcome, reduce mortality, decrease haematoma expansion or reverse the effects of NOAC.
We recommend idarucizumab to reverse effects of dabigatran in adult patients with ICH occurring during use of dabigatran. Evidence for effects on clinical endpoints is limited.

recommendations.section: PICO 9: Andexanet alfa in factor Xa inhibitor-related ICH
recommendations.text: We recommend using andexanet alfa if available - in adult patients with ICH occurring during use of rivaroxaban or apixaban. We also recommend randomising into trials as based on the low quality of evidence, there is significant uncertainty whether desirable outweigh undesirable effects.

recommendations.section: PICO 10: Ciraparantag in factor Xa inhibitor-related ICH
recommendations.text: We recommend against the administration of ciraparantag outside of clinical trials.
